summary: P1 candidate commit 9b7dc48 correctly implements all P1 dead-runtime and workflow-cleanup requirements. Removed runtime actors are absent from source, wheel and runtime defaults; strict config rejection, neutral active discovery, verify_fix-only history maintenance, C/C++ ruledriven rejection, canonical Candidate Ledger report authority, display-only Finding-root projection, workflow progress invariants and read-only compat isolation are consistent. fact-first and TerminalAuthority remain shadow, no scan-wide token hard cap was introduced, and product/truth/scorer change separation is maintained. No blocking findings were found.

non_blocking_findings.title: compat usage mapping includes the historical active_discovery label
non_blocking_findings.evidence: zscope/compat/usage.py maps the historical active_discovery label to hypothesis_hunter. The live P1 active_discovery component is distinct from the P4 Hypothesis Hunter; applying this compatibility mapper to live token events would misattribute usage.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep the mapper restricted to historical artifacts and retain an explicit caller contract or test proving that live ScanTokenUsageLedger events do not pass through the compat mapping.

checks.name: commit_tree_branch_clean_verified
checks.evidence: The review verified commit 9b7dc480533de051ec1ea533efae25cf3e58d1e2, tree 99b386fe89d9fe5ff30cdcd0f1aaed763c02ed57, branch codex/zscope2-p1-dead-code-workflow-cleanup and a clean worktree.

checks.name: dead_runtime_and_prompts_removed
checks.evidence: VulnerabilityAnalyzer, DeepWorker/SubAgentOrchestrator and IssueReconciler sources/prompts/tests are deleted; runtime defaults and the wheel contain none of them.

checks.name: strict_config_and_read_only_compat
checks.evidence: Removed agent/config names fail with migration guidance. compat returns detached migration/report/usage data and imports no Agent, LLM client, workflow executor or promotion path.

checks.name: active_discovery_and_history_maintenance_boundaries
checks.evidence: active_discovery registers candidates without proof or terminal authority and is not P4 Hypothesis Hunter. HistoryMaintenanceAgent accepts verify_fix only.

checks.name: ruledriven_public_contract
checks.evidence: C/C++ ruledriven raises an explicit ClickException before index/model work and points to the default Candidate Ledger; Java continues to use RuleDrivenAnalyzer.

checks.name: canonical_live_report_authority
checks.evidence: Single-entry and batch live reports require frozen Candidate Ledger outcomes. A missing ledger fails closed and an empty outcome list remains canonical without falling back to raw entry issues.

checks.name: finding_root_display_only
checks.evidence: Finding-root v2 projects display roots and aliases but does not acquire proof, promotion or terminal authority.

checks.name: workflow_handler_progress_invariants
checks.evidence: All declared steps require handlers; each in-scope step records completed, skipped or failed exactly once, and stop-driven skips record stopped_after:<step>.

checks.name: wheel_and_import_graph
checks.evidence: The 235-entry local wheel records zero entries for vulnerability_analyzer, deep_worker, subagent_orchestrator and issue_reconciler, while active_discovery, history_maintenance and compat package data are present.

checks.name: product_truth_scorer_separation
checks.evidence: The candidate differs from the P0-complete base only in product/governance/test scope and does not modify Range truth, fixture or Scorer files.

checks.name: shadow_and_budget_invariants
checks.evidence: fact-first and TerminalAuthority remain shadow, P2 qualification is still required for cutover, and no product scan-wide token hard cap exists.

checks.name: local_quality_gates
checks.evidence: The reviewer accepted the recorded 1872 passed/7 skipped full pytest result, compileall, mypy, WSL Black 25.11.0 on 48 changed Python files, benchmark hygiene, wheel/import gate and design-evidence gate.

checks.name: frozen_answer_free_replay
checks.evidence: The hash-bound P1 replay records zero model calls, no network use and stable Candidate Ledger, terminal, Finding-root/alias, report-view and workflow-progress semantics.

limitations: The review was read-only; it did not independently rerun the full local test suite.
No remote CI ran because no push or PR was authorized.
Native Windows Black hangs during grammar initialization; the accepted Black 25.11.0 result ran in an isolated local WSL environment.
Three large historical P0 benchmark aggregates are absent from this worktree; their hashes remain bound by P0 evidence and strict external-artifact replay was not possible.
ADR-0005 and ADR-0006 were not read directly by the reviewer; their effects were checked through source, the reachability manifest and design-manifest bindings.
No external-model benchmark was executed and no new Range quality result is claimed.
P2, P3, P4, P5, E0, P6 and P7 remain unapproved.
attestation: I approve only the Z-Scope 2.0 P1 product architecture scope at clean commit 9b7dc480533de051ec1ea533efae25cf3e58d1e2 and tree 99b386fe89d9fe5ff30cdcd0f1aaed763c02ed57. I performed a read-only review, did not read Range truth or benchmark answer content, did not execute a benchmark, made no repository edits, and made no P2, P4 or P5 approval claim.
